prd_facts.fact: Delivery (shipping) is free for every VIP order, with or without a coupon and whatever the amount after discounts.
Regular (non-VIP) customers are unaffected: they pay the flat shipping fee of 15.00 below the free-shipping threshold of 200.00 and ship free at 200.00 or more.
The flat shipping fee rule is rewritten so it states the VIP exception; the PRD does not keep a rule saying shipping always costs the flat fee for every order.
The VIP discount of 15%, the coupon percentage, the 30% cap and how they add up do not change.
The receipt still lists a Shipping line, which shows 0.00 for a VIP order.
Applies to every order from now on, with no flag and no migration.
